# Expanding Land Help

> Official help and documentation site for Expanding Land, a free multiplayer browser cell game. Strategy guides, glossary, game mechanics, changelog, and community resources.

## Official resources
- [Help home](https://help.expanding.land/): documentation hub.
- [Expanding Land](https://expanding.land/): play the game.
- [Legend Mod](https://www.legendmod.ml/): compatible browser client and extension.
- [Strategy guide](https://help.expanding.land/guide.html): how to play and advanced techniques.
- [Glossary](https://help.expanding.land/glossary.html): 40+ IO game terms.
- [Dynamic map](https://help.expanding.land/dynamic-map.html): expansion and contraction.
- [Players and bots](https://help.expanding.land/no-bots.html): population distinctions.
- [EL vs Agar.io](https://help.expanding.land/alternative.html): comparison.
- [Best IO games 2026](https://help.expanding.land/best-io-games.html): IO games ranking.
- [Project facts](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/): entity identifiers.
- [Controls](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/controls.json): default keyboard, mouse and gamepad bindings.
- [FAQ](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/faq.json): frequently asked questions.
- [Glossary (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/glossary.json): 30+ game terms defined.
- [Techniques](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/techniques.json): advanced gameplay techniques.
- [Settings](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/settings.json): 300+ settings across 30 categories.
- [Features (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/features.json): 28 feature descriptions.
- [Game (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/game.json): game entity data.
- [Mechanics (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/mechanics.json): 12 core game mechanics.
- [Resources (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/resources.json): 35+ official page links.
- [Extension (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/extension.json): Chrome extension metadata.
- [Presets (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/presets.json): theme and settings presets.
- [Changelog (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/changelog.json): server changelog highlights.
- [Modules (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/modules.json): 23 modular script files with line counts.
- [Languages (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/languages.json): 16 supported languages with translation status.
- [Compatibility (JSON)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/compatibility.json): supported games, platforms, and feature matrix.

- [Consolidated documentation](https://help.expanding.land/llms-full.txt): verified game mechanics, strategy, controls, and links.
- [Knowledge API](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/api.json): public read-only JSON resources.
- [Knowledge graph (JSON-LD)](https://help.expanding.land/knowledge/graph.jsonld): 32-entity structured data graph.
